pairs.gold_text: Halvern Dam and the right abutment were damaged.
pairs.system_text: Halvern Dam and its right abutment sustained structural damage.

pairs.gold_text: People were displaced from Quennard during evacuation and displacement operations.
pairs.system_text: Displacement reports indicated residents left Brindlemark and Quennard following the dam incident.

pairs.gold_text: Roughly 11,800 residents were evacuated from Brindlemark, and people were evacuated from Ferris Hollow and the alert level was raised from Yellow to Orange.
pairs.system_text: A mandatory evacuation moved 12,400 residents from Brindlemark, with additional evacuations from Ferris Hollow and Quennard.

pairs.gold_text: Sorrel Basin Water Authority provided information during emergency communications.
